name: @tevm/zig
description: Zig core for Voltaire - Ethereum primitives, cryptography, and precompiles

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../.. && zig build build-ts-wasm build-ts-wasm-fast crypto-wasm && mkdir -p packages/voltaire-zig/wasm/crypto && cp wasm/*.wasm packages/voltaire-zig/wasm/ && cp wasm/crypto/*.wasm packages/voltaire-zig/wasm/crypto/
scripts.format:check: echo 'Zig formatting checked in lint job'
